decisions.reason: Because this 2023 automation offering still fits the firm's digital-efficiency trajectory and project-based municipal adoption is often slow, an expanding firm with R&D slack would usually keep it unless results had clearly fallen below aspiration.

As a solution close to the firm's established business and customer efficiency goals, it is likely to stay on the market when there is no strong sign of performance below aspiration and the firm can absorb some uncertainty.

This 2024 mechanical water-control product is close to the core offer, so management would normally keep it for another cycle while learning from early demand unless sales were distinctly disappointing relative to expectations.

The energy management system is strongly aligned with the firm's stated direction toward digitally networked, efficient and environmentally oriented infrastructure, so behavioral management would tolerate early uncertainty and keep it.

A dedicated product line for water-level regulation with several models suggests committed commercialization, and in a growing infrastructure market the firm would likely retain it unless feedback clearly lagged aspiration levels.
